warnings: This is a STRUCTURAL roof-framing plan (steel members with printed sections and marks) — recorded as pattern 'plan' per the roof_plan vs plan rule (§1), not as 'roof_plan'.

The roof is a full-hip 'X' plan (matches the architectural roof plan on หน้า04 and the two ridge levels in the grid master's z_levels, 7.789 m over the main volume and 8.654/8.798 m at the secondary ridge/apex). Members run diagonally (hip/valley/ridge) rather than along the main x/y grid, so grid_ref_start/grid_ref_end (which assume a straight grid-to-grid span) do not apply cleanly — each diagonal member is instead given a short descriptive grid_ref (e.g. 'corner A1 to ridge apex') at reduced confidence, consistent with the standing rule against inventing false-precision grid coordinates.

'จุดติดตั้งเหล็ก PLATE หนา 9 มม.' (9 mm steel connection plates, shown as circled points where hip/valley/ridge members meet) are fabrication/connection details, not separate structural members — not itemised as elements, only noted here.

Purlin spacing and cross-bracing ('ตะเข้สัน'/'ตะเข้ราง' cross members visible as thin double lines between the main diagonals) are not individually itemised — only the primary named members (จันทัน, ตะเข้สัน, ตะเข้ราง, อกไก่) with their printed steel sections are recorded.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'roof_frame_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 5 roof-framing elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
